result: Lean module PregenesisContextFidelity compiles under Lean 4.35.0 with pinned Mathlib v4.35.0, built through lake from the PregenesisContextFidelity library registered in lean4/lakefile.lean. The module imports no Mathlib. Every printed axiom list is a subset of propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. There is no sorry, admit, axiom, native_decide, or unsafe. The node stays OPEN.
proof_boundary: Narrowed two-value carrier only. Replay is the left fold of supplyDiamond and designateA from false. A one-step trace valid at s' is not valid at s when s differs from s'. A contract preserves trace validity at replay(H) if and only if it accepts a context only when the context equals replay(H). The history supplyDiamond replays to false and answers verified; supplyDiamond then designateA replays to true and answers retracted. There are 2 unequal state pairs and 7 histories of length at most 2. Trial 2, Result 15, Prompt 12, the Prompt 17 window, and the Rust certifies predicate are not this carrier.
